summary: Rockwell Automation reported Q2 earnings on May 5, 2026: EPS $3.30 vs $2.88 consensus, revenue $2.24B vs $2.16B estimate. Raised FY2026 EPS guidance to $12.50-13.10. Stock jumped 5.4% to $459.35 on May 6. HSBC raised PT from $445 to $490. Goldman, BNP Paribas, Evercore also raised targets. SVP Matthew Fordenwalt sold 600 shares at $449.58 on May 5. Another SVP Lifecycle Services sold 460 shares.
